fields.System.Title: INV-601 — Create a batch on receipt
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want a batch record created when tracked stock is received, so that
expiry and traceability follow the stock for the rest of its life.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a batch-tracked product, when stock is received with a batch number, then a
  • batch record is created with its expiry and receipt date.
  • - Given the same batch number received again for the same product, then the existing
  • batch record is reused, not duplicated.
  • - Given an expiry-tracked product with no expiry supplied, then the receipt is rejected.
  • - Given an untracked product, then no batch record is created and the balance batch
  • field stays null.
  • - Given a batch, then every subsequent movement of that stock carries it.

Traceability
